offering_description.value: Provides outsourced human resources, payroll, and employee benefits administration to small and mid-sized businesses, plus workers' compensation insurance and staffing services. It delivers these through a professional employer organization model, with service fees charged per employee and insurance premiums.

primary_services.value: professional employer organization services; payroll processing; human resources administration; workers' compensation insurance; staffing services

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses across many industries

end_markets.value: construction; manufacturing; professional services; healthcare; general small business

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-employee fees for payroll, HR and benefits administration; interest or premiums: workers' compensation insurance premiums paid by client companies; project or contract: staffing services billed under client contracts
revenue_model.category: service fees; interest or premiums; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in client employee and payroll data, sells HR outsourcing to small and mid-sized businesses; financial intermediary: takes in insurance premiums, provides workers' compensation coverage to client companies

geography_served.value: US national: offices across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: PEO and HR services, workers' compensation insurance, and staffing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling to business owners; own locations: branch offices serving client companies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensing and state PEO licensing, workers' compensation regulated by state insurance regulators

notes: The exact share of staffing versus PEO revenue and the current list of states served are uncertain.
